_llm_instructions: Fill out the 'value' properties for each field in this CONTRACT CLOSEOUT REPORT template based on the provided project context.

Quality.guidance: Describe aspects of product quality that were handled well.

Schedule.guidance: Describe aspects of the contract schedule that were handled well.

Cost.guidance: Describe aspects of the contract budget that were handled well.

Other.guidance: Describe any other aspects of the contract or procurement that were handled well.

Change ID.guidance: Enter the change identifier from the change log.

Change.guidance: description Enter the description from the change log.

Date.guidance: approved Enter the date approved from the change log. Describe the dispute or claim.

Date resolved.guidance: Enter the date the dispute or claim was resolved.
